layout: Only row 0 columns 0..3 are populated: standing, sitting, walk-a, walk-b. Other cells are transparent reserved capacity. This is the user-requested front-only four-pose subset, not a completed four-direction animation set.
shadow: Generated translucent floor shadow included per frame. Do not double-render; future split shadow pass requires mask/extraction work.
pivotMeaning: Bottom center of included floor shadow; chair/desk masking must be validated by runtime owner.
